text: My method finds no base for the ticket to stand on: structure 53.7 is weak and D swing LH/LL, so no completed consolidation and no pivot (R3, C12, C14). The weekly HH/HL is trend, not a base, and day_vol 1.55 cannot rescue a missing base. 'A pullback that holds the broken level' names a level my method cannot locate. Invalidation observable I would use: a daily close under the D swing low on day_vol 1.40 or more. What clears me: structure rebuilt above 70 with a completed daily base, then a close above its pivot on day_vol 1.40 or more. Until then OPPOSE.
